rows.notes: Deliberate thought silence.

rows.en: ...Confirmed hits on the target!
That's my old man! His aim is dead on.

rows.notes: Pain vocalization in the nightmare.

rows.en: Wait, what...!? What is that reading!?

rows.notes: Pain vocalization in the nightmare.

rows.en: C-Captain! The Army-type units are multiplying again!!
rows.notes: Army-type units is the source-literal Devil Gundam minion classification, not Gespenst Army units.
uncertain: Army-type units has no independently established MX canonical English entry; source-literal classification.

rows.en: Formation D! All units, intercept!

rows.notes: Pain vocalization in the nightmare.

rows.en: #男愛称, I'm moving up! I need you to cover me!!
rows.notes: Speaker asks protagonist to provide covering fire; request direction preserved.

rows.en: D-don't go...! Folia...!
rows.notes: Protagonist begs Folia not to advance; hidden speaker labels remain hidden. Folia short name confirmed centrally from Akurasu OGG references.

rows.en: Don't worry! Besides, I can't let my old man see me looking bad!
Stop, Folia...!
rows.notes: Folia short name confirmed centrally from Akurasu OGG references.

rows.en: This is Black Wolf! Forward, report your status!
rows.notes: Black Wolf callsign follows Albero glossary alias; hidden speaker label remains ???. Forward retained as source radio address without invented full identity.
uncertain: Forward is a source-literal radio address; no independently established MX canonical English entry.

rows.en: C-Captain! The main body... The main body is starting to regenerate!!
W-what...!? What the hell is that thing!?
Black Wolf to all units! Fall back immediately! Get away from the Devil Gundam!
rows.notes: Black Wolf callsign follows existing Albero glossary alias; hidden speaker label stays ???.

rows.en: W-we won't make it!!
#男愛称! You have to run! Get out of here!!
Folia...!!
rows.notes: Name-only cry preserved. Folia short name confirmed centrally from Akurasu OGG references.

rows.en: W-waaaaaah!!
rows.notes: Fear scream preserved.

rows.en: FOLIAAAA!!
rows.notes: Elongated shouted name preserved. Folia short name confirmed centrally from Akurasu OGG references.

rows.en: ...It was... a dream...
Tch... I've started having that same dream again...
Guh!?
rows.notes: Pain grunt preserved.

rows.en: U-ugh...!
rows.notes: Pain grunt preserved.

rows.en: My medicine... has worn off...?
rows.notes: Medicine wearing off, not supply running out; ignored stray wrapper/end break.

rows.en: #男愛称, it's time to go see Lieutenant Douglas.
G... ugh... I need... my medicine...!
rows.notes: Restored implied need for medicine; distressed pauses retained; ignored stray wrapper/end break.

rows.en: #男愛称? Hey, #男愛称!
Uuugh... Guh...!
rows.notes: Pain vocalization preserved.
Name-only cry preserved.

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'. The line is reused in i00r0a:3/16/62/97 (the interlude), so it is a neutral silence.

rows.en: What's wrong!? You're white as a sheet!
I-it's nothing. It'll... pass soon...
Don't tell me you're having another one of those attacks...?
#女愛称... Didn't you say... you couldn't go into... a single man's room...?
rows.notes: Recalls her prior refusal to enter a single man's room.

rows.en: This is no time to be talking about that!
Are you really all right!? Shouldn't you go to the infirmary!?
Leave me alone...
I can't leave you alone! If anything happens to you, I'm the one who'll be in trouble!
rows.notes: Partner insists on intervening because consequences would trouble her.

rows.en: Shut up...
...I'm going to ask Lieutenant Douglas to change our duty rotation.
rows.notes: Proposes changing the duty rotation to excuse protagonist from patrol.

rows.en: Don't meddle...!
What are you talking about!? You can't do patrol duty in that condition!
I said, don't meddle!!
Wha...!
rows.notes: Interrupted startled interjection preserved.

rows.en: Come on! You don't have to get so angry!
...Let's go.
rows.notes: Invites partner to leave for the bridge together.

rows.en: Where are we going!?
rows.notes: Restored explicit subject and movement verb in question to protagonist.

rows.en: We're going to the bridge... To see Lieutenant Douglas.
rows.notes: Restored subject and movement verb in destination answer; bridge and Lieutenant Douglas retained.
Unfinished address to protagonist preserved.

rows.en: ...What's wrong with you two?

uncertain: Silent ……… rendered '...'.

rows.en: Did you two have a fight?
rows.notes: Douglas addresses both leads after their argument.

rows.en: No, it's nothing.
rows.notes: Dismisses Douglas's question.

rows.en: All right, then. Now, about the area you'll be patrolling...
rows.notes: Briefing deliberately trails off when the alert interrupts.

rows.en: What is it!?
rows.notes: Reacting to the alert.

rows.en: A report from a Federation reconnaissance plane! Numerous unidentified mobile suits have appeared at point F2309!
rows.notes: Reports location and unidentified affiliation; F2309 preserved.

rows.en: Can you identify them!?
rows.notes: Requests identification of the mobile suits.

rows.en: Please give me a moment...
rows.notes: Asks Bright to wait while checking.

rows.en: W-what is this!?
rows.notes: Stunned by what the identification shows.

rows.en: Torres, give me a clear report!
rows.notes: Captain demands a precise report.

rows.en: S-sorry, sir! B-but how can this be...!? Their code identifies them as Death Army!
rows.notes: Both stutters and interrupted disbelief retained.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Exclamation; deliberate interjection fragment.

rows.en: I'll put the reconnaissance plane's footage on screen!
rows.notes: Torres supplies the image Bright confirms next.
Pure shock punctuation retained.

rows.en: There's no doubt... It's the Death Army.
rows.notes: Visual confirmation.

rows.en: That's impossible...! A year ago, they were destroyed along with the Devil Gundam...!
rows.notes: Restores destroyed from the settled historical referent, while retaining trailing disbelief.

rows.en: Y-yes. I saw it with my own eyes...
rows.notes: Confirms witnessing their destruction a year ago.

rows.en: The Shuffle Alliance defeated that devil back then. I'm sure of it...!
rows.notes: Restores the context-settled defeat rather than retaining the Japanese omitted predicate.

rows.en: Damn it! Are you saying it's... the Devil Gundam has come back!?
rows.notes: Hugo responds with a trauma-driven outburst; nickname speaker stays a runtime placeholder.

rows.en: #男愛称!?
rows.notes: Name-only alarm retained.

rows.en: That can't be...! That can't be!!
rows.notes: Restores the predicate in repeated denial.

rows.en: H-hey! What's wrong with you, #男愛称!?
rows.notes: Aqua addresses the male lead directly; body placeholder preserved.

rows.en: All hands, Level 1 battle stations! Get the Nahel Argama to point F2309 at once!
rows.notes: Uses established battle-stations convention.

rows.en: Me! Number one in the Commander Ranking! Beaten?!
uncertain: Source is a defeat cry with no verb ('This me, No. 1 in the Commander Ranking...!'); 'Beaten?!' supplied from the context of a defeat line. 'Commander Ranking' from glossary term [jp].

rows.en: Nuuuoooh! Me... How could I, of all people...?!
uncertain: Source is a bare 'Me... this me?!' defeat cry; 'How could I' supplies the implied disbelief.

rows.en: Rom!!
Mark my words! I shall return!
uncertain: [jp] is English in katakana; rendered as plain English.

rows.en: Lord Gades, I served you faithfully! Why won't you come to save me?!
uncertain: ガデス様 rendered 'Lord Gades'; assumed the line is addressed to Gades (rescue plea).

rows.en: Ah, no! My Commander Ranking's gonna drop!
uncertain: Kansai-dialect comic line ('[jp]'); dialect conveyed only through casual register.

rows.en: Milady! Master Rom! I am terribly sorry!
uncertain: お嬢様 = Leina (Jim is Leina's servant) -> 'Milady'; ロム様 -> 'Master Rom'.

rows.en: What has justice ever done for me? Justice does nothing for anyone...
uncertain: くれる object not stated; 'for me' / 'for anyone' chosen.

rows.en: Pass this on! Tell them I fought a battle no martial artist would be ashamed of!
uncertain: 伝えてくれ has no stated recipient; kept unnamed ('Tell them'). Likely meant for Rom, not asserted.

rows.en: Brother Rom! I'm sorry!
Wh-wh-whoa! Rooom~!
I'm counting on you to carry on!
uncertain: 後を頼む: Rom asks the listener (his allies) to take over; listener not named.

rows.en: Unable to continue combat...
They got me?! No way!!
uncertain: やられた has no subject; 'They got me' (agent unspecified).

rows.en: Ah... Aaah?!
N-no way... Is this as far as I go...?!
Y-you're kidding! Me, of all people?! I can't believe it!
Ugh! I can't be like this... I just can't let it end like this!
uncertain: [jp]: the 'I' is inferred (Asuka berating herself).

rows.en: Yes... That's how it should be......

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled from glossary ＥＶＡ量産機 = 'Mass-produced EVA'.

rows.en: I'll leave your fate be... for now!
uncertain: [jp] (retreat line): 'I'll hold off on your fate for a while'.

rows.en: Careless of me... Is this the end...?!
Damn, is this as far as I go?!
No...! It can't be, not this!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; ガルファ speaker filled as 'Gulfer' (glossary term ガルファ, do_not_touch). Probably the generic Gulfer soldier unit (ガルファ素体 = 'Gulfer Soldier'); kept the shorter in-game label.

rows.en: O-Oyakata-samaaa!
uncertain: お館様 kept as 'Oyakata-sama' per glossary term.

rows.en: Wh-what?! Impossible!!
Th-this can't... This is absurd...!!
It's no good! I have to bail out!
uncertain: 脱出しないと has no subject; 'I' inferred (Kirakuni flies the Cell Fighter; not verified that it is solo).

rows.en: We have to... bail out...!
uncertain: 脱出しなきゃ has no subject; 'We' inferred because Dendoh is co-piloted by Ginga and Hokuto. This line is reused in 3 places (s00r00:32/33/173) and may play when Hokuto is in another unit - check.

rows.en: Is this the end...?!
Nuooooooh!!
It seems retreat is my only choice...!
uncertain: [jp]: subject inferred as 'my' (Vega speaking for herself); could be 'our' if she leads a group.

rows.en: Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor... Please... forgive me...
uncertain: [jp] -> 'Your Majesty, Gulfer Emperor' using glossary 'Gulfer Emperor' (note: glossary en_short for that entry is 'Galfa Emperor', inconsistent with en_full/do_not_touch 'Gulfer').

rows.en: B-bailing out~! Ryoko, don't get mad at me, okay?!
uncertain: 脱出 has no subject; rendered as 'bailing out' (Hikaru herself).

rows.en: Curses...! Hurry, all hands, evacuate!
Dammit! Is this how it ends?!
Wha! This is as far as I go?! How pathetic...!
uncertain: ここまでかよ / 情けねえ: subject 'I' inferred (Saburota about himself).

rows.en: Yu... Yurika......
In death, none shall gather my bones... To perish is my fate...
uncertain: [jp] is a stock oath phrase ('none will gather the corpse of the fallen'); rendered with 'my' since he is speaking of himself.

rows.en: Omoikane... I'm sorry. All hands, abandon ship!
This is the end... and that's a wrap...
uncertain: 一巻の終わり ('end of the scroll' = 'it's all over'); Izumi is a punster, 'that's a wrap' keeps the media idiom.

rows.en: Ngh! Next time, victory will be ours!
Uwaah! Captain, sir!!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio (captain) -> 'Captain, sir'.

rows.en: Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar scum!!
uncertain: 覚えていろ rendered 'you'll pay for this' (stock threat).

rows.en: Uoooooh?!
D-dammiiiit!!
Take care of my mom for me...!!
uncertain: 頼んだぜ: Kaine asks the listener (unnamed) to look after his mother; direction kept as a request.

rows.en: C-Colonel!!
uncertain: 大佐 = Gon Jem (colonel).

rows.en: What?! Waaaah!!
It's no good! I'm bailing out!!
C-Captain, sirrr!
uncertain: 大尉殿 = Meio.

rows.en: As long as I live, the Giganos Empire shall never fall...!
uncertain: [jp] literally 'as long as I am here'; 'as long as I live' chosen.

rows.en: Heh, so this is as far as I go...
Tch, that's all for today!
uncertain: ここまで: impersonal 'that's all for today' kept (Min retreating).

rows.en: Sorry! This is as far as I go!
Am I going down...?!
Ngh, how could this...
uncertain: なんという… trails off in the source; kept the omission.

rows.en: Ah, no...!
Waaaah!! I-it's no good~
Judau! They got me!
No no no no!
Dammit! Sorry, I'm bailing out!
D-damn! They got me!
This is... the end...
N-no good! I've been hit!
Big brother...!
uncertain: Leina's brother is Judau; kept as 'Big brother' rather than naming him, matching the source.

rows.en: Aah, why did this happen to me of all people!?
uncertain: Source is the fragment 'why this me!?' (nande kono atashi ga); restored a verb ('happen to me').

rows.en: No good! I'm bailing out!
My unit's already done for!? Amuro...!
uncertain: Source 'mou kitai ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'already done for' (unit destroyed).

rows.en: So this is it... All hands, evacuate!
I... I lost...!
uncertain: Source 'maketa no ka' has no subject; restored 'I' (Argo about himself).

rows.en: Ugh! D-Domon!!
Hahaha... It's no use! You have no chance of winning...
You lot are finished no matter whaaat!
Splendid... Gwaaah!!
Ugh... ugh... I... I lost...!
uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary (speaker_jp is the short form 'Saishi').

rows.en: Ugh, guh, ah, aaaagh!
Alas... My fate, too, ends here...
Jeeesus! You gotta be kidding me!
Graaaaaah!!
Brrrrrr...
uncertain: Horse noise (Fuunsaiki); kept as 'Brrrrrr...'.

rows.en: Waaaaagh!
D-Domooon!!
You'd better remember this, you bastard!
Wh-whoa-whoaaa~
uncertain: Boss's comic exclamation 'arryaryaaan' has no fixed English; rendered as a goofy 'Wh-whoa-whoaaa~'.

rows.en: Noooo~! Koji~!
Daaamn iiit!
I'm bailing out!
Oh, come on. Whoa!?
Oh well. I'm counting on you for the rest, everyone.
uncertain: Direction: 'ato wa tanomu ze, minna' = Hayato asking everyone to handle the rest.

rows.en: Kyaaaah! Ryo! Hayato! Benkei!
rows.notes: Source nickname maps to Ryo per campaign_terms.json and https://srw.wiki.cre.jp/wiki/流竜馬; full 竜馬 remains Ryoma.
uncertain: Source says 'Ryou-kun' (nickname for Ryoma). No glossary entry for the nickname; used glossary short name 'Ryoma'. Could be 'Ryo' if the project prefers nicknames. Honorific -kun dropped.

rows.en: Don't think this means you've won!
E-Emperor Burai!
Getter's power is... Dammit!
uncertain: Kept the source's cut-off: 'Getter's power is...' (predicate omitted in JP, deliberately unfinished).

rows.en: J-Juniooor~!
uncertain: Zuril cries out 'Junior'; glossary has the unit 'Zuril Jr.'. Referent inferred to be his Zuril Jr.; kept as 'Junior' since that is what he shouts.

rows.en: King Vegaaaa!
uncertain: 'Vega Daiou-sama': honorific -sama not rendered separately; 'King' carries it.

rows.en: I am the king of the universe, King Vegaaa!
Kyaaaah! Kojiii!!
Kyaaaah!
Damn, I got careless! Me, of all people!
U-urgh... Jigajiga... Is this as far as we go...!
uncertain: 'Jigajiga' = his Vega Beast (glossary: Vega Beast Jigajiga). Restored subject 'we' (Mors + Jigajiga).

rows.en: I'm counting on you all to protect the Earth!
uncertain: Direction: Duke asking the others (kimitachi de) to protect Earth.

rows.en: Kyaaah!! Daisuke!
uncertain: Honorific -san dropped.

rows.en: Ooooh! Ugwaaaaaagh~!
I'm sorry... Miku...
Nuooooooh!!
No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Source 'masaka, Zeorymer ga!?' omits the predicate; inferred 'is going down' (unit-destroyed line).

rows.en: No way! Zeorymer is going down!?
uncertain: Same line as 363 (Masaki instead of Masato); same inferred predicate.

rows.en: Impossible...! Omzack... my "Lightning"!
uncertain: Glossary unit is 'Omzack of the Lightning' (character entry for Saiga says 'Thunder'); used 'Lightning' to match the unit name.

rows.en: Tau... I'm sorry... I... you...!
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Aen' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Aen'; glossary only has the full form). Kept source omission 'watashi wa... anata wo...!' (no verb); the intended verb is not settled out of context. 'Tau' used bare as in source; glossary full name Shi-Tau.

rows.en: Big sister...
uncertain: speaker_en empty; filled 'Shi-Tau' from glossary (speaker_jp is short 'Tau').

rows.en: Y-Yuratei...
...I was careless... I... have lost...
Saiga... I... end here...
uncertain: Source 'watashi wa... koko de...' omits the verb; inferred 'end here' (dying/defeat).

rows.en: Damn... A lifelong disgrace for Kyoshiro Yuzuki!
Damn!! It's no good!
Ugh! I've been hit!?
Kyaaaah!!
Not yet! Raideen! Whoa!
This... can't be...!
Damn, it's no good!!
Waaaaaah!!
Eek!! No...!! It can't be!!
Ah! Is this the end!?
Kyaaah!!
Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Waaaaaah!!

uncertain: speaker_en was empty; filled 'Sai Saici' from glossary.

rows.en: Graaaaaah!!
Kyaaah!!
Uwaaagh!
uncertain: JP raw line lacks the closing bracket; translated the body only.

rows.en: 1. Destroy all enemies.
rows.notes: Player; victory objective; no dialogue referent. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: 1. Allied mothership is shot down.
rows.notes: Player; defeat objective; allied carrier condition. Decision: Restore settled subjects/actions in natural spoken English; preserve tone and row boundary.

rows.en: That nightmare has become real again...!
rows.notes: Beginning of map event 4, returning to the Death Army encounter.

rows.en: The enemy units have spotted us! They're preparing to attack!
rows.notes: Enemy reaction and attack preparation both preserved.

rows.en: Are there any heat signatures underground!?
rows.notes: Checks for the Devil Gundam's main body.

rows.en: No, there aren't!
rows.notes: Answers underground heat-signature query.

rows.en: Then the main body isn't here...!?
rows.notes: Thought kind retained; main body refers to the Devil Gundam.

rows.en: Are those things really mobile suits?
rows.notes: Child's surprised reaction to the Death Army.

rows.en: Y-yeah... I've seen them on the TV news...!
rows.notes: Removes malformed trailing Japanese quote and indent as instructed.

rows.en: All units, commence your attack!
rows.notes: Captain's attack order.

rows.en: H-how could this happen!? Bro!!
rows.notes: Feigns shock at defeat; Bro keeps Sai Saici's familiar address to Domon.

rows.en: Enough of your act. The Sai Saici I know is far stronger than that...!
rows.notes: Rejects the impostor's pretense after the defeat response.

rows.en: Y-you bastard... Domon Kasshu...!!
rows.notes: Hostile change of voice exposes the imitation; full name follows glossary.

rows.en: Impossible...! You struck me down without the slightest hesitation...!!
rows.notes: Defeat response directed at Domon.

rows.en: I never had any doubts to begin with.
rows.notes: Direct response to George's remark about hesitation.

rows.en: Because a puppet may imitate George... but it can never surpass him.
rows.notes: Puppet means this imitation of George, rather than George himself.

rows.en: H-heh heh... Just what I'd expect from Domon Kasshu...!
rows.notes: Unnerving laugh and grudging acknowledgment.

rows.en: DG Cells... I cannot allow this devilish technology to eat away at our beautiful Earth!
rows.notes: DG Cells follows glossary; Earth corruption and refusal preserved.

rows.en: Such false piety... Ideals, convictions, love, courage... all bow before power. Allow me to teach you that.
rows.notes: Addresses Duke with contempt, retaining all four ideals.

rows.en: Don't think you can read my moves!
rows.notes: Combat taunt to Duke.

rows.en: Those who drown themselves in twisted power will never win! We'll teach you that!
rows.notes: Responds to the corrupted fighter's boasting; plural allies preserved.

rows.en: You challenge me in such a feeble machine... Is this the Japanese specialty, kamikaze?
rows.notes: Retains national stereotype and suicide-attack taunt without softening.

rows.en: Shut up! Like hell I'll lose to someone who cheated to get that power!
rows.notes: Koji's forceful refusal to lose to illicit power.

rows.en: You bastard! Quit darting all over the place!
rows.notes: Complaint about Sai Saici's quick movements.

rows.en: You're challenging me in that tiny saucer? Do you want to die?
rows.notes: Targets Koji's saucer; no invented unit name.

rows.en: Don't let your guard down! Whatever its origins, this thing has the full strength of a Gundam Fighter!
rows.notes: Warns Getter teammates about the imitation's genuine fighting strength.

rows.en: Please don't misunderstand. My power has already surpassed that level.
rows.notes: Claims strength beyond the Gundam Fighter level Hayato just named.

rows.en: But as long as you use that power for your own selfish ends, we can't afford to lose!
rows.notes: Getter team's moral refusal to lose.

rows.en: Don't you get it...? How wonderful this power is!
rows.notes: Second sentence is a deliberate exclamatory elaboration of the first.

rows.en: If you earned that strength through training, you should hold your head high and be proud!
rows.notes: Conditional praise contrasts honestly trained strength with cheating.

rows.en: But you cheated to get your power. You've got no right to brag about it!
rows.notes: Answers Ryoma by denying the corrupted fighter's claim to pride.

rows.en: You've got some nerve... Then I'll make you feel my strength firsthand!
rows.notes: Threatens all Getter pilots with physical experience of his power.

rows.en: That's not right! The Shuffle Alliance are supposed to be heroes! You can't go around cheating!
rows.notes: Accuses apparent Shuffle Alliance fighters of betraying their heroic role.

rows.en: Say what you will. I'm now immersing myself in the exquisite melody of power...
rows.notes: Keeps George's affected musical metaphor, directed at Kaine.

rows.en: An ordinary fool like you could never understand this pleasure!
rows.notes: Elitist insult remains directed at Kaine.

rows.en: Hey, hey... You think you can catch me moving that slowly?
Shut up, you doping bastard! I'm only getting serious now!!
Domon... Are you really going to strike me down... your own friend?
Shut up! The George I knew had a heart as noble as a rose!
Compared to him, you're just a turtle in the mud, drowning in power!
rows.notes: Retains turtle-in-mud comparison against the noble rose.

rows.en: That's cold, bro. You're just going to abandon us?
rows.notes: Bro is a familiar address to Domon, not a claim of kinship.

rows.en: If you really are Sai Saici, I'll risk my life to save you...
But my heart... my fists tell me I must never forgive you!
Now they've shown up all the way over there!
Don't tell me they'll just keep coming, no matter how many we beat?
Yeah, they might. Self-replication is one of those DG Cells' traits.
Sheesh. I'd heard the rumors, but they're more trouble than I expected.
But I heard that thing had been completely scrapped...!
Did someone bring it back...!?
...Did you pick up any sign of our target?
rows.notes: Target remains unnamed and gender-neutral; hidden label preserved.

rows.en: No. It looks like our target isn't here.
rows.notes: Target remains unnamed and gender-neutral; hidden label preserved.

rows.en: Then we'll deal with the small fry. ...Are you ready?
rows.notes: Hidden label preserved.

rows.en: Yes, of course.
rows.notes: Hidden label preserved.

rows.en: All right...!
rows.notes: Hidden label preserved.

rows.en: Come oooout! Gundaaaaaam!!
rows.notes: Extended summoning shout retained.

rows.en: Haaaaah...! Hmph!!
rows.notes: Two martial exertion sounds retained.

rows.en: Th-that Gundam...!?
rows.notes: Exclamatory incomplete recognition retained; removes the draft extra question about identity.

rows.en: C-could it be!?
rows.notes: Deliberate recognition fragment retained.

rows.en: Come to me! Fuunsaikiiii!!
rows.notes: Canonical Fuunsaiki name inside extended shout.

rows.en: A horse!?
Could that be a Data Weapon!?
rows.notes: Thought, speculative Data Weapon comparison.

rows.en: No, that can't possibly be...
rows.notes: Thought; rejection trails off.

rows.en: Here I goooo!!
Hmph. They put up no fight. Is it because the main body isn't nearby?
A-amazing! He wiped out the enemy in no time at all!
That guy is...
rows.notes: Recognition sentence deliberately trails into row136.

rows.en: Domon Kasshu... the Shuffle Alliance's King of Hearts...!
rows.notes: Completes recognition begun in135; spoken identifying noun phrase.

rows.en: I-I know him!
He's the guy who fought Kazuya Ryuzaki in that epic final at the Colony Martial Arts Championship two tournaments ago, right!?
rows.notes: Two tournaments ago, not the immediately preceding championship. Measured overflow compression keeps opponent, championship, finals, excitement and two-tournament interval. Colony Martial Arts Championship is the centrally approved source-literal title, continuous with Stage04; independent canonical English unestablished.

rows.en: You sure know a lot about him, Ginga...
rows.notes: Ignores stray source closing wrapper.

rows.en: Yeah! Anyone who does martial arts would know that!
Domon Kasshu? From the Colony Martial Arts Championship...?
rows.notes: Question deliberately trails off after championship reference. Colony Martial Arts Championship is the centrally approved source-literal title, continuous with Stage04; independent canonical English unestablished.

rows.en: Yeah, he's the martial artist who fought that fierce battle against Kazuya Ryuzaki in the finals.
I watched the broadcast. That fight had me on the edge of my seat.
He's even better known as a member of the Shuffle Alliance.
Yeah. I hear he also showed up during the war with the Baam and helped Daimos and the Earth Federation Army...
I never thought that man would show up here...
rows.notes: Thought; surprised recognition of Domon.

rows.en: #男愛称... Do you know something about the King of Hearts and the Devil Gundam?
Hey, #男愛称. You've been acting strange for a while now.
#女愛称, switch the joint actuators' power source to the battery.
rows.notes: Joint actuators are switched to battery power; ignores stray source closing wrapper.

rows.en: Huh...!? That's supposed to be for emergencies...
rows.notes: Emergency-power explanation deliberately trails off.

rows.en: I need to be sure the machine will move.
Hey! Are you saying you can't rely on my power adjustments or my operation of the machine!?
rows.notes: Female lead challenges male lead distrust of her power control and operation.

rows.en: Our fight with them isn't over yet...
rows.notes: Thought; their battle is not over.

rows.en: They're a lot tougher to kill than that...!
rows.notes: Thought; their tenacity exceeds the apparent easy defeat.

rows.en: #男愛称! You're hardly one to talk! Are you sure you're physically all right!?
rows.notes: Female lead challenges male lead own bodily condition.

rows.en: Just switch it over. Do you want to die here?

rows.notes: Wordless shock at the threat of death; retained punctuation-only source.

rows.en: F-fine! But you had better explain yourself later!
rows.notes: Aqua reacts to Hugo ordering the battery switch; preserved stammer and demand for a later explanation.

rows.en: We have an incoming transmission.
rows.notes: Bridge transmission exchange; restored scene-settled subjects and preserved officer register.

rows.en: Put it through to me.
rows.notes: Bright asks Saegusa to route the transmission to him.

rows.en: It has been a while, Colonel Bright Noa.
rows.notes: Bridge transmission exchange; restored scene-settled subjects and preserved officer register.

rows.en: Yes. Not since the Devil Gundam incident, Rain Mikamura.
rows.notes: Bridge transmission exchange; restored scene-settled subjects and preserved officer register.

rows.en: Please be careful, everyone. More enemies may still appear.
rows.notes: Bridge transmission exchange; restored scene-settled subjects and preserved officer register.

rows.en: No, they are already here!
rows.notes: Bridge transmission exchange; restored scene-settled subjects and preserved officer register.

rows.en: Captain! We have detected an object rapidly approaching this area!
rows.notes: Bridge transmission exchange; restored scene-settled subjects and preserved officer register.

rows.en: So they have come! All units, stay alert!
rows.notes: Bridge transmission exchange; restored scene-settled subjects and preserved officer register.

rows.en: ! Dragon Gundam and Gundam Rose!?
rows.notes: Arrival of Sai Saici and George; addressed names and titles follow glossary; preserved surprise.

rows.en: Hey, big bro Domon!
rows.notes: Big bro is Sai Saici's familiar address to Domon, not a literal sibling claim.

rows.en: It has been a while, Domon Kasshu.
rows.notes: Arrival of Sai Saici and George; addressed names and titles follow glossary; preserved surprise.

rows.en: You two...!
rows.notes: Retained deliberate recognition fragment addressed to both arriving fighters.

rows.en: Could those guys be...
rows.notes: Retained trailing question; Light supplies the Shuffle Alliance identification next.

rows.en: Yeah. Sai Saici, the Club Ace, and
rows.notes: Sentence continues into row 173; retained matching conjunction boundary.

rows.en: George DeSand, the Jack in Diamond... They are members of the Shuffle Alliance.
rows.notes: Completes identification begun in row 172; full names and Shuffle titles follow glossary.

rows.en: Sai Saici, George... Why are you here?
rows.notes: Arrival of Sai Saici and George; addressed names and titles follow glossary; preserved surprise.

rows.en: Is it not obvious? We in the Shuffle Alliance must deal with the aftermath of that dreadful incident...
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: That's right, big bro. So come on, let's fight again! It's been a while!
rows.notes: Fight is an invitation to Domon, not a joint fight against enemies. Final restores Sai Saici's casual spoken voice; wording is longer than the saved draft, not a fit compression.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: What are you playing at, Sai Saici!?
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: I'm telling you, let's do it! Our kind of battle... a Gundam Fight!!
rows.notes: Final restores Sai Saici's casual spoken voice; wording is longer than the saved draft, not a fit compression.

rows.en: This guy...!?
rows.notes: Retained demonstrative thought fragment; Domon is suspicious of Sai Saici.

rows.en: W-what is that boy saying!? This is no time for that...!
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: I will serve as the witness. Come, Domon... Do not hold back.
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: All right. Everyone else, please stay out of this.
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: Haaaa...! Hah!!
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: Well then... Here I come, big bro!
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: Gundam Fiiight!
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: Reaaady!
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: Gooooo!!
rows.notes: Sai Saici challenges Domon to a duel; preserved challenge direction and launch-call shouts.

rows.en: 1. Reduce Dragon Gundam's HP to 50% or less
rows.notes: Victory condition; retain one plain segment.

rows.en: 1. God Gundam is shot down@2. An allied mothership is shot down
rows.notes: Defeat conditions; preserve one @ and two numbered segments; repeated at s0130:374.

rows.en: Ow, ow... You are as good as ever, big bro!
rows.notes: After duel damage, Sai Saici reveals unnatural power; preserved strained laugh or wordless reaction as applicable.

rows.en: ...You are not putting up your usual fight, Sai Saici.
rows.notes: After duel damage, Sai Saici reveals unnatural power; preserved strained laugh or wordless reaction as applicable.

rows.en: Heh, hehehehe...
rows.notes: After duel damage, Sai Saici reveals unnatural power; preserved strained laugh or wordless reaction as applicable.
After duel damage, Sai Saici reveals unnatural power; preserved strained laugh or wordless reaction as applicable.

rows.en: But I... I have to beat you this time, big bro.
rows.notes: After duel damage, Sai Saici reveals unnatural power; preserved strained laugh or wordless reaction as applicable.
After duel damage, Sai Saici reveals unnatural power; preserved strained laugh or wordless reaction as applicable.

rows.en: So, you see, I got my hands on...
rows.notes: Object deliberately withheld until row 198; retained matching fragment.

rows.en: This incredible power!!
rows.notes: Object completing row 197; deliberate cross-row fragment.

rows.en: T-that is! A self-regeneration function!?
rows.notes: Rain identifies the Dragon Gundam repairing itself; function is technological, not a Spirit Command.

rows.en: Just as I thought, you two...!
rows.notes: Retained deliberate suspicion fragment before Sai Saici names DG Cells.

rows.en: That is right, big bro! DG Cells!
rows.notes: DG Cells follows glossary capitalization.

rows.en: You know very well how wonderful they are, do you not? Hehehehe.
rows.notes: They refers to DG Cells; restored explicit English referent.

rows.en: I once rejected this power... But what about you? Why not acquire it yourself?
rows.notes: George invites Domon to acquire DG-cell power; he is not asking Domon to give it away.

rows.en: I refuse!
rows.notes: DG-cell reveal and Domon's refusal; preserve George's affected courtesy and Domon's forceful denial.

rows.en: My, my, you are as stubborn as ever. Then I suppose we must resort to force.
rows.notes: DG-cell reveal and Domon's refusal; preserve George's affected courtesy and Domon's forceful denial.

rows.en: Domon! I do not know how it happened, but those two are infected with DG Cells!
rows.notes: DG-cell reveal and Domon's refusal; preserve George's affected courtesy and Domon's forceful denial.

rows.en: No! That is absolutely impossible!!
rows.notes: DG-cell reveal and Domon's refusal; preserve George's affected courtesy and Domon's forceful denial.

rows.en: What!?
rows.notes: DG-cell reveal and Domon's refusal; preserve George's affected courtesy and Domon's forceful denial.

rows.en: How could men who inherited the Shuffle Crest during that battle... ever submit to the Devil Gundam!
rows.notes: Refers to Sai Saici and George inheriting Shuffle Crests during the earlier battle; masculine men is explicit in source.

rows.en: Heh heh... I understand why you would want to believe that, Domon...
rows.notes: The impostor George patronizes Domon after his refusal to believe the real Shuffle Alliance would submit.

rows.en: We needed power beyond what the Shuffle Alliance could give us...
Yes... We needed it to protect the Earth Sphere.
rows.notes: Restores the impostors as subject; Earth Sphere is the source geographic scope.

rows.en: I remember... Something like this happened before...!
We can save them both if we use the same method we used back then!
They don't need saving! I'll defeat them!
rows.notes: Domon rejects the premise that the two need rescuing, anticipating the impostor reveal.

rows.en: W-what are you saying, Domon!?
Captain Bright, order every unit to attack!
...Are you sure that's what you want?
They're your comrades, aren't they!? Why won't you save them!?
Because, as I just said, there's no need to...!
Are you sure that's true...!?
Yes! I swear it on this fist!
T-that's crazy! If you're wrong, this could be a disaster!
Nah, you don't have to worry about that.
What!?
That guy swore on his own fists. A martial artist trusts those more than anything. That's why I believe him.
rows.notes: Domon is the martial artist referred to; fists are an oath and basis for trust.

rows.en: I-is that really how it works...!?
If he's that certain, he must be right...
All units! Attack those two Gundams!
A-are you sure, Captain!? Aren't they members of the Shuffle Alliance, just like Domon Kasshu...!?
rows.notes: Keeps the trailing objection as a question with an unfinished emotional ending.

rows.en: If they're infected with DG Cells, we should be rescuing them instead!
Do it! I'll take responsibility! Commence the attack immediately!
The enemy units' signals have vanished!
Captain, does that mean those Shuffle Alliance members were impostors...?
Yes... Domon realized that, which is why he didn't hesitate to fight them...
They were after me... So I was the one they lured out.
rows.notes: Thought; the enemy lured Domon himself rather than being drawn out by him.

rows.en: Domon Kasshu, I'd like to hear the details, if possible. Would you come aboard with Rain?
Yes, understood.
rows.notes: Ignores the documented stray closing-wrapper tail.

rows.en: So there were signs of the Death Army appearing several days ago...
Yes... There were signs in the ruins around TOKYO JUPITER, of all places...
rows.notes: Restores the signs and their existence from Bright239; TOKYO JUPITER spelling fixed by glossary.

rows.en: But... Why would they appear there?
We came to the Japan region to investigate the cause, but... We still don't know the details.
But by sending impostors of those two, they've revealed that one of their aims was to draw us away.
rows.notes: Diversion means drawing Domon and Rain away; preserves one of several purposes.

rows.en: Who are you talking about?
rows.notes: Restores the question about the referent of they.

rows.en: The people plotting to revive the Devil Gundam. Though we still have no idea who they are...
But weren't all the DG Cells completely disposed of after that incident?
Yes. Dr. Raizo Kasshu, Domon's father and the developer of the machine that became the Devil Gundam, destroyed them...
rows.notes: Mother/base machine means the predecessor that became Devil Gundam; does not imply a biological mother. Full name Raizo Kasshu is explicitly recorded in the main Dr. Kasshu glossary profile notes.

rows.en: Then why the hell have they shown up again now?
Someone probably obtained a sample of DG Cells during the Devil Gundam incident.
But aren't there plenty of people who would scheme to do something like that?
Right, right. I saw it on TV too. The Guiana Highlands, Lantau Island...
rows.notes: List trails off into the explanation in252; stray closing-wrapper tail ignored. Guiana Highlands and Lantau Island confirmed centrally from Akurasu A/64 flow charts.

rows.en: The Devil Gundam seemed to show up in all sorts of places.
Yes... It caused quite an uproar. I imagine it was fairly easy to get hold of a sample.
Dr. Raizo was concerned about that too. After the incident, he developed a vaccine that induces apoptosis in DG Cells.
rows.notes: Retains the technical apoptosis mechanism, not a general antidote. Full name Raizo Kasshu is explicitly recorded in the main Dr. Kasshu glossary profile notes.

rows.en: With that vaccine, we in the Shuffle Alliance defeated people planning to misuse DG Cells, but...
rows.notes: Contrast trails into Rain256; subjects restored.

rows.en: The vaccine doesn't work on these Death Army units.
So, just as before... We have no choice but to physically destroy them.
What did you say...?
So those Death Army units we just fought were made from DG Cells that had been improved somehow?
Yes... Dr. Kasshu said that would be impossible without extremely advanced technology...
rows.notes: Kasshu is the authority quoted; technological actor remains unspecified.

rows.en: If even their creator says so, it must be some incredible technology.
Could it be the Gulfer?
We looked into that possibility too, but so far, there doesn't seem to be any connection.
Then who on earth are they...?
We intend to keep investigating that.
So, to carry on our investigation, could you let us stay aboard the Nahel Argama?
I was about to ask you to join us myself. However...
rows.notes: Bright welcomes their joining; unfinished caveat retained.

rows.en: I understand. As a member of the Shuffle Alliance, I intend to do what must be done.
rows.notes: Domon acknowledges Bright's implied duty to assist the ship; does not invent the caveat.

rows.en: Then I'm counting on both of you from here on.
rows.notes: Request direction preserved: Bright asks for continued help from both.

rows.en: Yes.
By the way... Captain Bright, have you met Rain and Domon before?
Yes. We also took part in the final battle against the Devil Gundam a year ago.
Wow...
The Nadesico B was there too, you know!
Now that's quite a lineup.
That wasn't all. Every Gundam there was came together to defeat the Devil Gundam...
rows.notes: Torres's unfinished account retained.

rows.en: And on top of that, the King of Hearts standing right there...
rows.notes: Unfinished predicate retained as Torres is interrupted by embarrassed Domon/Rain.

rows.en: Hmm...
L-let's save that story for another time. Right, Domon?
rows.notes: Rain deflects Torres's account; stutter retained.

rows.en: Y-yeah...

rows.notes: Source question-mark-only reaction retained.

rows.en: W-well, we have maintenance to do on the God Gundam, so we'll be going now.
What's with those two? Why are they in such a hurry?
I don't know...?
...Torres, keep that story a secret for their sake.
rows.notes: Bright protects Domon and Rain's private story.

rows.en: Yes, that does seem best.
Now you've made me even more curious.
Everyone has things they'd rather keep private. Let's stop prying.
Hmm... I'm not sure how convincing that is.
rows.notes: Light privately questions Vega's persuasiveness; restored subject/verb.

rows.en: All right, #男愛称. You're going to explain what happened earlier, aren't you?
What happened between you and the Devil Gundam?
Did you fight it... back when you were in that special task force?
And how are you connected to the King of Hearts...?
rows.notes: Aqua's unfinished question retained, with context-settled you restored.

rows.en: That was a close call back there, Domon.
Yeah.
But... it's only a matter of time before everyone finds out.
You're right...
rows.notes: Ignored stray closing bracket and trailing source layout marker.

rows.en: ! Domon Kasshu...
rows.notes: Recognition/exclamation and name fragment retained.

rows.en: If this man had finished it off sooner, the Cry Wolves would have...
rows.notes: Unfinished counterfactual about the Cry Wolves retained; it refers to Devil Gundam.

rows.en: No... I suppose I'm wrong to resent him.
From what I've heard, the Devil Gundam and DG Cells changed his life, just as they changed mine...
rows.notes: His refers to Domon; source explicitly calls him a man. Parallel lives retained.

rows.en: Hey! Where are you going, #男愛称?! I'm not finished talking yet!
...Domon, that person... do you know him?
rows.notes: Rain asks Domon about the male protagonist; gender established by runtime male-lead placeholder.

rows.en: No... I've never seen him before.
rows.notes: Domon denies knowing male protagonist.

rows.en: Then what is going on with #男愛称...?
rows.notes: Aqua remains puzzled about protagonist after Domon's denial; open-ended referent retained.
uncertain: Source leaves what about the protagonist is being asked open; rendered as a general question about his behavior.

rows.en: U-um!!
rows.notes: Nervous attention-getting interjection.

rows.en: Oh... Could you be Dendoh's pilot?
Y-yes! I'm Ginga Izumo!!
Ginga, what's wrong? You're all tense...
I-I-I'm nervous! Th-the King of Hearts is standing right in front of me!!
rows.notes: Repeated stutter and enthusiastic nervousness in front of hero preserved.

rows.en: Hee hee, so Domon's the one you wanted to see.
...What do you want?

rows.notes: Stutter chosen as S to preserve sweeping/sign callback through497.

rows.en: S-sign an autograph for me, please!! I'm a fan of yours, Domon!
rows.notes: Sign phrasing transcreates source autograph stutter to preserve cleaning joke sound callback.

rows.en: So please, I want the King of Hearts' autograph!!
rows.notes: Explicit asking for autograph, not offering own autograph.

rows.en: Domon, give him one. We're going to be together from now on.
rows.notes: Rain asks Domon to sign for Ginga because they will be comrades.

rows.en: Then there's no need.
Huh!?
rows.notes: Event 4: body-only spoken dialogue; speaker and listener follow the original route context.

rows.en: If you're a martial artist too, you should understand. My emblem... The King of Hearts is already engraved on your heart.
rows.notes: Domon's literal emblem metaphor; no actual signature granted.

rows.en: ...As proof that we're comrades who will fight together.
rows.notes: Deliberate appended phrase explaining the metaphor in502.

rows.en: S-so... So cool...!
I'm sorry, Ginga. He's just embarrassed. He's not used to signing autographs.
rows.notes: Domon's embarrassment and lack of autograph practice restored explicitly.

rows.en: He's embarrassed... that's what that was?
rows.notes: Hokuto challenges Rain's reading of Domon's refusal to sign an autograph.

rows.en: Yes. I've been his partner for a long time... I can tell.
She can tell because she's his partner, huh...
rows.notes: Aqua echoes Rain's understanding of her long-term partner.

rows.en: That might be impossible for me and #男愛称...
rows.notes: Aqua compares her partnership with the male protagonist, not their ability to obtain an autograph.

rows.en: So it might have been fairly easy to get a sample.
rows.notes: Alternate route: sample refers to DG Cells, following Death Army/Devil Gundam discussion.

rows.en: What...?!
rows.notes: Alternate route: reacts to vaccine failure and required physical destruction.

rows.en: But it's a problem when we have no idea who's behind this.
rows.notes: Alternate route replaces Vega's Gulfer hypothesis with unknown culprit concern.

rows.en: Yes. That's why we intend to keep investigating them.
To do that, Captain Bright... could you let us stay aboard the Nahel Argama?
rows.notes: Alternate route explicit address to Captain Bright retained.
